subject.title: feat: centralized filename encoding utility for multi-encoding Content-Disposition handling

question: Where should the shared multi-encoding filename decoder live, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/71517 be refreshed or replaced?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent boundary affects core media helpers, bundled channel plugins, and plugin-facing reuse, so automation should not choose that API direction alone.

options.title: Use a plugin-safe media decoder
options.body: Move the decoder into media-core or an explicit plugin-safe SDK boundary, then refresh the candidate or replacement around that single helper.

options.title: Keep narrow channel repairs
options.body: Treat current Feishu fixes as sufficient for now and defer non-Feishu multi-encoding cases until concrete channel reports arrive.

options.title: Require broader live repros first
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for real non-Feishu channel failures before approving a shared utility interface.

recommendation.title: Use a plugin-safe media decoder
recommendation.body: Move the decoder into media-core or an explicit plugin-safe SDK boundary, then refresh the candidate or replacement around that single helper.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Feishu filename work makes this the strongest available owner for the channel/media boundary decision.
